properties.note: pre-reaction state is the isolated planar Cs cyclopentadiene molecule (no separate complex possible for an intramolecular shift). Atom order: 1-5 C, 6-11 H; sp3 carbon = C3 bearing H8/H9 (task map labels this H as H6 on C3).

Symmetric suprafacial [1,5]-H saddle: migrating H bridges C2/C3 at 1.315/1.315 A, 1.064 A above the planar ring; ring bonds 1.412/1.490/1.412/1.404/1.404 A. Imaginary mode 91% on the migrating H. Bidirectional IRC (81 points, max at RxCoord=0) descends to two cyclopentadiene frames (-193.97608 Ha each) that re-optimize to the same minimum.
degenerate product, sp3 carbon now at C2; E(P)-E(RC) = +0.00000009 Ha. Duplicated by calc/product_min_opt_freq.log and by the workflow endpoint logs.

edges.channel: concerted suprafacial [1,5]-sigmatropic H shift through one C2v-like 6-centre cyclic TS

properties.note: H6 migrates C3->C2 (map indices); C1=C2 and C4=C5 become single, C3-C4 and C1-C5 become double. Barrier is electronic (no ZPE/thermal): E(TS1)-E(RC) = 0.042359325 Ha.

edges.channel: same saddle, mirror-equivalent automorphic labelling (H6 migrates C3->C4; C5<->C2, C1<->C4 relabelling of e1)

properties.note: Not an independent step: the C2v TS is symmetric in the atoms of the C2-C3 bond, so the two labellings describe one physical barrier; reported for completeness of the degenerate notation.
